claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission is sending four astronauts named Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is to test the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems.
